desc:
CHEX MIX: Snack Mix loaded with fun, flavorful shapes of Chex, pretzels, rye chips, and breadsticks

SAVORY SNACK MIX: With Corn Chex, Wheat Chex, pretzels, rye chips, and mini breadsticks lightly seasoned in a Sour Cream and Onion flavor, you'll get crunchy and delicious all in one

PARTY FAVORITE: Endless taste and texture combinations make it the perfect party mix snack for get-togethers of all shapes and sizes; Not your standard pub mix, trail mix, or bar snack

EASY AND PORTABLE: Stock your pantry with this delicious snack to share with friends and family

CONTAINS: One 8 oz bag of Chex Mix Sour Cream and Onion Snack Mix
features:
Features

Savory & Tangy Flavor

Features a rich sour cream and onion taste that’s creamy, zesty, and satisfying.

Textural Variety

A crunchy blend of multiple shapes and textures creates an engaging snack experience.

Lower Fat than Regular Chips

Contains about 60% less fat than traditional potato chips, offering a lighter snack option.

Benefits

Guilt-Friendly Indulgence

You can enjoy the bold, savory flavor without consuming as much fat as typical chips.

Ideal for group settings like parties, office lunches, game nights, or road trips.

Familiar and widely loved flavor profile that appeals to both kids and adults.

Easy to pack in lunchboxes, purses, or car consoles for on-the-go snacking.
ingredients: Whole Wheat, Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Enriched Flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, riboflavin, thiamin mononitrate, folic acid), Vegetable Oil (soybean, high oleic soybean, high oleic canola, high oleic sunflower, palm, fractionated palm and/or palm olein), Rye Flour, Sugar, Maltodextrin, Dried Buttermilk. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Dried Onion, Dried Sour Cream (cream, nonfat milk, cultures), Yeast, Baking Soda, Spice, Yeast Extract, Distilled Monoglycerides, Natural Flavor, Malted Barley Extract, Barley Malt Syrup, Yellow Corn Flour, Trisodium Phosphate, Calcium Carbonate, Rye Flour, Fumaric Acid, Caraway, Sodium Diacetate, Dried Soy Sauce (soybeans, wheat, salt), Caramel Color. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
